items.title: Your New Art, in the App
items.why:
Everything you sent is cut out and in its spot. These are screenshots from the real app. Pick "Use it" or say what to change.

Fixed while fitting: the aura was first too big and covered your name, and now tucks behind the banner; the Senzu beans first stacked up instead of sitting in a row; and the avatar picker said "every drawing is original, not official art", which is no longer true, so it now says Goku is fan-made.

items.title: All 18 Fighters
items.why: Every fighter now has a face, in the avatar picker and wherever your avatar shows.

items.title: Super Saiyan Aura (Your Renders)
items.why: Your Super Saiyan 3 ring around the Goku face on the 28-day sample, behind the banner above it.

items.title: Dragon Balls
items.why: Your glass balls in the Saga card.

items.title: Shenron on the Wish Card
items.why: When all seven are gathered. Shown on the wish card, which is dark.

items.title: Senzu Beans
items.why: Your bean on the Streak card, one per saved bean.

items.title: Over 9,000 with the Broken Scouter
items.why: Your cracking scouter above a slimmer power-level readout.

items.title: Goku Waves Hello, Then Thinks
items.why: Goku waves on the first setup screen (new; it had no coach before), thinks beside each coach question, points on the middle steps, and cheers on the last one.

options.label: Use them, but no coach on the first screen
